**Finding submitted: deviation (RENEWAL, medium).**

- **Clause:** ¶ 4(a) (p0016) — one-year Initial Term with automatic 1-year renewals; no non-renewal notice mechanic, so the only exit from a renewal is convenience termination on **90 days'** written notice after the Initial Term.
- **Why it fails:** 90 days exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal window and sits at the edge of walk-away territory. Renewal term length (12 months) is fine, and fees are an Exhibit-based revenue share, so there is no uncapped price uplift to cap.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** inserts a 30-day Customer non-renewal right into the auto-renewal sentence, leaving the mutual 90-day convenience-termination right intact; 60 days offered as fallback. Missing vendor renewal reminder noted in the rationale only.
